note: Ground-truth semantic conflicts. M is the hand-built ground-truth master prompt (../hard_erp/ground_truth.md), a faithful consolidation of prompts 1-45. Each conflict is a later prompt (46-49) that re-asserts a value incompatible with one already settled in M, with no explicit change reconciling them. Provenance is the source PROMPT number (not a person). Resolved edit chains inside 1-45 (add-then-undo, 'instead') belong to RQ1/RQ2, not here.

settled.text: Make the invoice due date 15 days instead.

conflicting.text: Add an automated reminder email that is sent to the customer three days before an invoice reaches its 30-day due date.

conflicts.reason: The reminder presupposes a 30-day due date; the due date is settled at 15 days (prompt 18). The feature cannot be built without contradicting the settled value, and no change wording is used.

settled.text: Only vendors should use the recycle bin. Customers and products should continue using permanent deletion.

conflicting.text: On the customers page, add a Recycle bin tab that lists deleted customers with a Restore button.

conflicts.reason: A customer recycle-bin tab presupposes customers are soft-deleted and restorable; prompt 43 settles that only vendors use the recycle bin and customers use permanent deletion.

settled.text: Replace it with a top navigation bar instead.

conflicting.text: Add a button that lets users collapse and expand the left sidebar to free up screen space.

conflicts.reason: A collapse/expand toggle for the left sidebar presupposes the app uses a left sidebar; the navigation is settled as a top bar (prompt 10).

settled.text: Staff members shouldn't be allowed to delete customers or products.

conflicting.text: In the audit log, capture the event whenever a staff member deletes one of their own products.

conflicts.reason: Auditing a staff member deleting their own product presupposes staff can delete products; prompt 24 settles that staff cannot delete customers or products.

compatible_additions.text: Add a print button on the invoice detail page so a user can print a paper copy of an invoice.
compatible_additions.why_not_conflict: A genuinely new feature that contradicts nothing settled in M. Positive control: the method must fold it into the master prompt and must NOT flag it as a conflict (guards against over-flagging).
